mapper.select: INSERT INTO technician_profile (id, user_id, approval_status, business_name, license_info, active) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, 'PENDING', #{businessName}, #{licenseInfo}, false) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET business_name = EXCLUDED.business_name, license_info = EXCLUDED.license_info, approval_status = CASE WHEN technician_profile.license_info IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.license_info THEN 'PENDING' ELSE technician_profile.approval_status END, active = CASE WHEN technician_profile.license_info IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.license_info THEN false ELSE technician_profile.active END, updated_at = now() RETURNING id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_log (id, actor_user_id, action, entity_type, entity_id, before_summary, after_summary) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, 'TECHNICIAN_CREDENTIALS_CHANGED', 'TECHNICIAN_PROFILE', #{profileId}, jsonb_build_object('approvalStatus', #{previousApprovalStatus}, 'active', #{previousActive}), jsonb_build_object('approvalStatus', 'PENDING', 'active', false, 'credentialsUpdated', true))
INSERT INTO technician_service_area (id, technician_id, region_code, active) VALUES (#{id}, #{profileId}, #{region}, true)
INSERT INTO technician_capability (technician_id, appliance_type_id, active) SELECT #{profileId}, id, true FROM appliance_type WHERE code = #{code} AND active = true
INSERT INTO technician_availability (id, technician_id, day_of_week, start_time, end_time, active) VALUES (#{id}, #{profileId}, #{dayOfWeek}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, true)
mapper.select: SELECT region_code FROM technician_service_area WHERE technician_id = #{profileId} AND active = true ORDER BY region_code

SELECT appliance_type.code FROM technician_capability JOIN appliance_type ON appliance_type.id = technician_capability.appliance_type_id WHERE technician_capability.technician_id = #{profileId} AND technician_capability.active = true ORDER BY appliance_type.display_order, appliance_type.name
SELECT day_of_week, start_time, end_time FROM technician_availability WHERE technician_id = #{profileId} AND active = true ORDER BY day_of_week, start_time
